description: Fixed diagnosis-to-intervention mapping for the retention agent. This is the single source of truth — the system prompt and the dashboard UI both read from this file so the playbook can never drift out of sync between what the model is told and what the frontend displays.

categories.name: Delivery handoff failure
categories.action_description: Route to the customer's original selling advisor for a warm call plus a complimentary inspection offer.

categories.name: Cost or transparency distrust
trigger_signals: complaint_text or survey comment references pricing, unexpected charges, or feeling uninformed
categories.action_description: Offer a fixed-price, itemized, photo-documented estimate ahead of the next visit.

categories.name: Convenience or wait-time friction
trigger_signals: complaint_text or survey comment references appointment delay, wait time, or slot availability
categories.action_description: Offer a priority or express appointment slot, or a pickup-and-drop-off convenience service.

categories.name: Genuine quality dissatisfaction
trigger_signals: repeated complaints referencing the same underlying issue
low survey score tied to a specific visit
categories.action_description: Escalate to the service manager for direct human review. No customer-facing message is auto-drafted for this category.

categories.name: Silent drift
trigger_signals: no complaint_text or survey comments at all
service visits stopped with no recorded reason
categories.action_description: Send a personalized reminder referencing the customer's specific vehicle and service history, with a light, no-pressure offer.

categories.name: Competitive defection risk
trigger_signals: vehicle age approaching or past typical warranty expiry
no strong signal pointing to categories A through D
categories.action_description: Offer a competitive service value package, explicitly timed around the warranty window, framed against independent-garage pricing.
